name: kaggle-mcp
description: Kaggle (competitions): discover, get_competition, standings, my_entries. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_kaggle_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KAGGLE_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_kaggle_api_token.description: Kaggle API token from https://www.kaggle.com/settings/api ('Generate New Token'; the value the CLI reads from KAGGLE_API_TOKEN / ~/.kaggle/access_token). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: `kaggle competitions list` (ListCompetitions {search, page}); `id` is the competition ref (URL suffix, e.g. `titanic`) that the other tools take. The page size is the server default (20; `limit` is not sent) and the response has no total. `kind` and `status` are not sent (the CLI's group/category enums do not match the vocabulary). tags (objects), teamCount, userHasEntered and userRank stay in `raw`.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: GetCompetition {competitionName: <ref>}. `submission_format` is the evaluation metric name; maxDailySubmissions, maxTeamSize, mergerDeadline and isKernelsSubmissionsOnly (code competition) stay in `raw`.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: `kaggle competitions leaderboard -s` (GetLeaderboard, public leaderboard in rank order). Only the first page: the API pages with nextPageToken, which the vocabulary's `page` cannot carry. `score` is a string in the API, so it stays in `raw.score` (with teamId); there is no rank field, rows come in leaderboard order.

tools.name: my_entries
tools.description: `kaggle competitions submissions <COMPETITION>` (ListSubmissions): your submissions for one competition, so `competition_id` is required in practice. publicScore/privateScore are strings in the API and stay in `raw`, with description, fileName and errorDescription.
